{"type":"thought","data":"I found useful data "}
{"type":"thought","data":"on the RCP page."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nRealClearPolling shows"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a 38.1% approval average"}
{"type":"thought","data":" for Trump from September"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 21 to October 11. Morning"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Consult, Rasmussen "}
{"type":"thought","data":"Reports, and other polls"}
{"type":"thought","data":" range from 36% to 44%."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nAdditional polls show"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a wide spread. Pew "}
{"type":"thought","data":"Research and AP/NORC"}
{"type":"thought","data":" show 30% to 31% approval."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Emerson, Quinnipiac,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and I&I/TIPP show 34%"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to 39%. Harvard-Harris"}
{"type":"thought","data":" shows 42%. RCP metadata"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is dated December 4,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" but the poll data runs"}
{"type":"thought","data":" through October 11."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nMacroMicro also reports"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 38.10% on October 12."}
{"type":"thought","data":" APP.com shows 37.8%,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" which may be stale."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The trend from October"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 5 to October 12 is "}
{"type":"thought","data":"downward: 38.5% to 38.3%"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to 38.1%. The latest"}
{"type":"thought","data":" RCP average sits at"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the 38.4% threshold."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe current average"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is roughly 38.3%, about"}
{"type":"thought","data":" three points below "}
{"type":"thought","data":"the 38.4% threshold."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The resolution date"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is October 16, giving"}
{"type":"thought","data":" about three days to"}
{"type":"thought","data":" wait. The raw poll "}
{"type":"thought","data":"data totals 575 across"}
{"type":"thought","data":" fifteen surveys, which"}
{"type":"thought","data":" would yield an average"}
{"type":"thought","data":" near 38.3, yet RCP "}
{"type":"thought","data":"reports 38.1."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nRCP likely excludes"}
{"type":"thought","data":" polls marked with asterisks."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Removing THP/MM and"}
{"type":"thought","data":" AP/NORC leaves thirteen"}
{"type":"thought","data":" surveys averaging roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 38.46, still not matching"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the reported 38.1. "}
{"type":"thought","data":"The displayed figure"}
{"type":"thought","data":" probably reflects a"}
{"type":"thought","data":" different weighting"}
{"type":"thought","data":" scheme.\n\nReaching 38.4"}
{"type":"thought","data":" by October 16 requires"}
{"type":"thought","data":" about a 0.3 point increase"}
{"type":"thought","data":" in three to four days."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Historical moves show"}
{"type":"thought","data":" approval can shift "}
{"type":"thought","data":"by roughly 0.3 points"}
{"type":"thought","data":" in that span."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe market prices "}
{"type":"thought","data":"Yes at 18.5% and No "}
{"type":"thought","data":"at 81.5%. That implies"}
{"type":"thought","data":" roughly an 18.5% chance"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of hitting the 38.4%"}
{"type":"thought","data":" threshold.\n\nA 0.3 point"}
{"type":"thought","data":" move in three days "}
{"type":"thought","data":"is within recent historical"}
